Sandbox_DelCarClaim_MaxCars_tooltip: How many vehicles one player can claim for themselves. Organization vehicles do not count.
Sandbox_DelCarClaim_OrgMaxCars_tooltip: How many vehicles the head of an organization (Delirium Economy) can claim for it. Its head and staff can use them.
Sandbox_DelCarClaim_InactivityDays_toolt: A personal claim ends when its owner has not logged in for this many real days; an organization claim, when neither its head nor any of its staff has. Using the vehicle does not matter. 0: claims never end.
